name: Marbles
source:
You're locked in the basement with four strangers during a Halloween party. The offer to tell scary stories is on the table. Is that chill down your spine from the stories or something else?

[From [URL=https://garbledmess.itch.io/marbles]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
万圣节派对上，你和四个陌生人被锁在了地下室里。有人提议讲鬼故事。那股沿着脊背爬上的寒意，究竟来自故事，还是别的什么？

[摘自[URL=https://garbledmess.itch.io/marbles]itch.io[/URL]]
